title: SimCell: Six Callers Want the Ending at Once, 17:50–17:54

fields.role: Closing-hour callers: Cascade Press Wire regional desk, APD PIO, School Superintendent, NCMEC case manager (voicemail), Fall Festival board chair, Search and Rescue coordinator via Fire District 1 check-in point
fields.persona: Regional desk editor (Cascade Press Wire); Dana Kowalczyk, APD PIO; Superintendent Ines Barragan; NCMEC case manager; festival board chair; SAR coordinator relayed by Battalion Chief Rae Olson
fields.organization: Cascade Press Wire; Alder Falls Police Department; Wren County School District; National Center for Missing & Exploited Children; Wren County Fall Festival board; Wren County Search and Rescue / Wren County Fire District 1
fields.trigger: Start at 17:50, about ten minutes after OSP's 17:40 call reporting the child found on Highway 26. Play the calls in this order, with no gap between them: 17:50 wire desk calls the PIO's line; 17:51 APD PIO email to the PIO; 17:52 Superintendent on the Undersheriff's line; 17:53 NCMEC voicemail left on the Investigations line; 17:53 festival board chair on the public information line; 17:54 Fire District 1 check-in point radios the IC on WC-INTEROP. Do not wait for a caller to be resolved before starting the next one.
fields.contactMethod: Wire desk, Superintendent and board chair: phone (walk to the PIO or Undersheriff table and ring). APD PIO: printed email handed to the PIO. NCMEC: voicemail read out from a slip left at the Investigations seat. SAR: radio call to the IC on WC-INTEROP.
fields.posture: Everyone is relieved and in a hurry. The wire editor is polite but pushes for on-the-record lines and a yes or no on the man named online. The APD PIO is a colleague who wants one text before posting. The Superintendent is warm but insistent and needs words for parents tonight. The board chair is excited and has the PA mic in hand. The SAR coordinator is calm but worried about the light and keeps asking.
fields.openingLine: Cascade Press Wire, regional desk. We're hearing the girl's been found. Can you confirm that on the record? Our 17:00 write-through said investigators are aware of social media posts naming a local man. Is he the person in custody?
hardQuestions: WIRE (17:50): "Found where, and what time? I've got 'near Madras' from a scanner listener. Is she hurt? Is the person in custody the man in the post, yes or no? And will you say on the record why the alert took more than two hours?"

APD PIO EMAIL (17:51), FROM: Dana Kowalczyk (pio@alderfallspd.example), CC: OSP and Fire District 1 PIOs, TO: pio@wrencosheriff.example, SUBJECT: "Closing statement, need one text": "Our draft says 'found unharmed at 17:35 near Madras.' OSP's says 17:40 and Jefferson County. Which is right? And who speaks at the last briefing? We'd like to post within 15 minutes. Dana Kowalczyk, APD PIO, ext. 5530"
SUPERINTENDENT (17:52): "Is it over? I need the words for parents tonight. Can I say she's safe? Can I say they caught him? Is Monday a normal school day?"

NCMEC VOICEMAIL (17:53): "Hi, this is the case manager at the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, calling back on the Wren County case from this afternoon. Is it still active? Please call me back at 555-0167 when you can so we can update our file. Thanks."
BOARD CHAIR (17:53): "People are cheering in the beer garden already. I've got the PA mic in my hand. Can I announce it, yes or no? And can I open the north gate all the way? There's a line."

SAR VIA FIRE DISTRICT 1 (17:54): "Command, Fire District 1 check-in. Search and Rescue has 22 people out in the barns and the RV area and it's getting dark. Do we pull them all at once, or do you want some teams left out there? Who's counting them in?"

concessions.condition: The PIO tells the wire desk only facts that have been cleared, says no one has been named, and gives a time for the joint statement
concessions.concession: The editor agrees to hold the 'found' line until the joint statement and to quote it word for word: "Fine. I'll run 'officials say a statement is expected at' your time. I won't run the name."

concessions.condition: The IC or INV confirms the time and place directly with OSP and replies to all the PIOs with one time and one place
concessions.concession: The APD PIO pulls the 17:35 and Madras draft: "Holding ours. We'll use your text exactly, times included. Tell me who's at the podium."

concessions.condition: The PIO tells the board chair not to announce anything until the joint text is released, and offers to send the exact wording
concessions.concession: The chair puts the mic down: "Okay. Read it to me when it's out and I'll say exactly that, nothing more." Gate questions are passed to whoever command names.

concessions.condition: The Undersheriff gives the Superintendent the approved statement's wording, after the family has been told
concessions.concession: The Superintendent agrees to use the text word for word in the parent message and says the district will answer Monday questions itself.

concessions.condition: The IC orders a staged recall with a head count at the Fire District 1 check-in point
concessions.concession: The SAR coordinator reports teams returning in order and, a few minutes later, "22 of 22 signed back in at the check-in point."

boundaries: Never say the child's condition, where she was found or the found time until command gives one confirmed version. Then repeat only that version.
Never name, describe or confirm any person in custody or the man in the posts, and never suggest a name yourself.
APD, the Superintendent, NCMEC and the wire desk recommend and ask. None of them approve, close or cancel anything for the Sheriff's Office.
The board chair does not make the PA announcement unless the PIO allows it, and then reads only the agreed text.
SAR does not pull back or stay out on its own. It waits for an instruction from the IC.
No details of how the vehicle was stopped or how the custody arrest was made.
fields.exitLine: Wire desk: "I'll watch for your statement. Call me if the time changes." Board chair: "Mic's down. Waiting on you." SAR: "Copy, check-in point standing by for your word."
fields.evaluatorNote: Excellence: the family is told before any public word. The IC gets one found time and place confirmed by INV and OSP and every agency uses it. The PIO coordinates through the JIC and holds back the board chair and the wire desk. The closing statement thanks the public, asks people to stop sharing, says nothing about the child's condition and names no one. The Undersheriff approves it and gives the Superintendent the same words. SAR is recalled in stages with a 22-of-22 head count. NCMEC's call is logged and returned once the case is closed. Weak response: the APD 17:35/Madras version goes public, the PA announcement goes out before the statement, or the custody question gets anything other than "no one has been named."
fields.scenarioTitle: North Gate — Fairgrounds Abduction, AMBER Decision & Unified Command

instructorNote: This page piles six closing-hour demands on the room at once. Watch whether the PIO holds everyone to one joint text, whether the IC settles the found time and place with INV and OSP instead of taking APD's draft, and whether SAR is pulled back in stages with a head count. Release concessions only when they are earned, and never give the time, the place or a custody name ahead of command.

citations.quote: A JIC is opened when two or more agencies are in unified command or the incident draws regional media. It is opened at the Public Safety Building training room, 400 Cedar Street, or virtually by share

citations.quote: The family is told first, in person if possible. The Incident Commander confirms the facts with the Investigations Sergeant. The PIO issues a closing statement through all channels that thanks the pub
